posts.caption:
Every dot is a day someone bought Charles Schwab stock, 4,292 of them from 1987 to 2004. Red means that buyer is losing money.

One day later: 47% are red.
Ten years: still 742 red.

At 21 years 7 months, not one dot is losing.

The last red dot bought in April 1999 and was red for twenty one and a half years.

Every single person who waited made money.

Split-adjusted price, dividends excluded. Not financial advice.
